newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Bank Austria off after issue price.
newsitem.headline: Bank Austria off after issue price.

text.p: Bank Austria preferred stock fell 3.85 percent in Vienna on Friday as the bank announced a lower-than-expected issue price for almost eight million new shares and investors took fright at political in-fighting.
At 0937 GMT Bank Austria preferred shares were 16 schillings down at 400, making them by far the biggest loser in an otherwise firm market.
Earlier the bank said it would issue 7.98 million new preference shares at a price of 376 schillings each in a public tender from June 9-23 to raise three billion schillings in fresh equity capital.
"The shares were a little cheaper than people had expected," a Vienna trader said. At the start of the week analysts were forecasting an issue price above 400 schillings.
Dealers added that a political disagreement over Bank Austria's privatisation had undermined investor confidence.
"Demand has fallen away rapidly recently because of all the political squabbling," one market participant said. -- Vienna newsroom. +43-1 531 12 254
